campaign.title: K17a primitive-conductor parity and literal orientation-defect gate

resource_policy.computation_policy: No numerical theorem evidence is planned. Exact finite checks may be used only to falsify algebra or normalization and cannot promote the asymptotic target.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact primitive-conductor parity projection prove the complete signed high-q K17a block (177.K34), prove a strict literal symmetric-orientation conductor sector, or isolate the first exact orientation-defect capacity or self-return obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: |sum_(u0|u) sum_(ell mod u0, u0/(ell,u0)>Q_B) c_(u0)(ell) H_(kappa,u,u0,ell)| <<_(B,delta,gamma,epsilon) L X^epsilon uniformly for each supported (kappa,u), with one final outer absolute value.
quantities: u_0 and every exact conductor q divide the odd primitive modulus inherited from the accepted cross-gcd fold.
The candidate primitive kernel is K_q(b)=sum_((a,q)=1)c_q(a)e(ab/q).
The candidate parity identity must be derived with its d=1 term and exact q/u_0 normalization.
A fixed (kappa,u,u_0) stratum has O(u_0 L) atoms and exact-q positive capacity O(L q log(2q)).
Every q<=Q_B packet is already proved; only q>Q_B belongs to this round.
The stronger aliaswise (177.K35), K26, other parents, bridges, and exponent work are forbidden pivots.

completion_criteria: Independently derive the exact primitive-frequency Mobius projector and sign-reversal law, including the d=1 trace.
Derive the exact two-orientation bucket decomposition with b a unit modulo q and every coefficient factor correct.
Prove or refute target-safe summation of the primitive trace over q|u_0 and u_0|u.
Attack the complete literal orientation defect before any positive norm, retaining selectors, squarefree and coprimality fields, physical lifts, phases, endpoints, and zero extensions.

Prove (177.K34), prove a complete nontrivial literal defect sector at target scale with its complement stated, or establish the first exact selector, multiplicity, capacity, or self-return obstruction.
Run an arbitrary-bucket false control without treating it as literal lower mass.
Do not pivot to (177.K35), K26, another M2 or M1 owner, GAR, assembly, a bridge, or an exponent.
Close under exactly one authorized exit label after seam review.
